node.statement: Perturbation to the chart point. For ||A||<=4delta put X=V bold-dot (J+A)=V+V bold-dot A. The product-norm axiom and node 1.1.1 give ||L_X-L_V||<= (1+e)||X-V||<=4(1+e)^2(1+2s)delta<=8delta, whence ||L_V^(-1)(L_X-L_V)||<=16delta<=16s<1. The Neumann lemma makes L_X=L_V[I+L_V^(-1)(L_X-L_V)] invertible. Solving L_X(Y_X)=J then gives X bold-dot Y_X=J, so X has a right inverse.
